tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lcam dral dang lha brgyad sogs kyi ru mtshon 'dzugs chog gi rnam bzhag dang dbyangs rol chog khrigs kyi tho dge/ ru mtshon 'dzugs chog la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ tshar chen gyi gsung 'di 'bring po'i rgyas pa yin zhing / 'dir 'bring po kho na bya tshul ni/ bsham tshar chen gyi gsung 'di sor bzhag bdag bskyed bla med yin phyin mchog sgrub yi dam gang rung gi byas pas chog kyang / 'dir kyai rdor bya ba'i dbang du btang nas gnas yo byin rlabs nas lam dus kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya/ bum bskyed ni kho bos sbyar ba'i dam tshig bskang gso'i gong bzhin/ sbyang khrus ni/ oṃ sarba bighnān zhes pa nas/ bzang khrus rdzogs pa'i bar rgyun gyi gzhi bdag khrus gsol bzhin la bden bdar nas don gnyis lhun grub ltar la/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi brlabs kyis dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi zhes sam/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhes lcam dral dang lha brgyad kyi khyad sbyar/ gang ltar na'ang phyi rten ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa la zhes pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan 'dra/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni gzhung bzhin ru mtshon bskyed chog la/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i rjes su/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i zhes sogs gtor bsngo bzhin la/ lcam dral yin na ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bhyo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ de rnams kyi mdun du sogs bran bdud bskyed pho nyar 'gyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bhyoḥya rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min rnam par nas/ lha mo dang ni rjes su lho phyogs ri rab kyi khong gseng nas/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / spyan 'dren gyi tshig ni gtor bsngo bzhin la sngags/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes mchod pa dang dam bzhag sogs thams cad la rigs 'gre/ 'bul sngags lcam dral la rgyun bzhin dang / de rjes bran bdud nang mchod kyang lcam dral gyi mthar bran bdud kyi sngags la 'bru gsum sbyar bas phul/ 'dod gsol la rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran bdud gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams zhes sbyar/ 'di gong gi dam bzhag la'ang rigs 'gre/ lha brgyad yin na bskyed chog sogs gzhan thams cad gtor bsngo sor bzhag la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba zhes pa'i rjes su bran bdud bskyed/ spyan 'dren gyi tshig la rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las mkhan pho nya rnams dang / khyad par lho phyogs ri rab kyi khong gseng nas sogs yang mtshungs/ gzhan tshig bsgyur mi dgos las mgon lnga la gtor ma phul ba'i rjes su bran bdud la phul/ rakkha si'i rjes su ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā rā dang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul ba tsam dmigs bsal/ khyad par gyi spyan 'dren la/ lcam dral yin na/ hūm̐ dpal ldan nas/ re ma ti zhes pa'i bar dang / de rjes/ sprin ltar 'thibs pas 'dir gshegs shig glog ltar 'khyug pas sogs gzhung bzhin lha brgyad yin na/ gnod sbyin yab yum sogs nas/ gnas 'dir gshegs kyi rjes su/ sprin ltar 'thibs pa sogs/ gang ltar na'ang bcom dung dang / da ring gi byin 'bebs/ da ring gis dbyangs 'khor gsum bcas dang / dpon slob mang du yod na/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril g.yab dar byed tshul kho bos sbyar ba'i mgon mdos kyi phyag deb bzhin/ hūm̐ yod pa'i 'go rnams su tshig rol/ tshig rol rjes ma rdzogs nas chems rdung / lcam dral ltar na yi ge bcu gcig pa/ e ka dza ṭi/ lha mo/ bran bdud rnams kyi sngags kyi mtha' dang / lha brgyad ltar na mgon po'i sngags gsum/ yum chen/ lha mo las mkhan gyi bod pa gnyis/

bran bdud kyi sngags mthar/ e sogs gzhung bzhin byas la/ len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ mchod sngags dang mtshan sngags sbyor tshul ni gong gi rigs 'gre/ 'og gi rang yi dam du zhes sogs yar blangs la khril li li yod par gyur/ zhes brjod na legs/ lcam dral la shā sa na kho nas go chod/ lha brgyad la so so'i sngags dang bod rbad bsad gsum gyi khyad par yod pa rnams la 'dres par bzlas nas/ rang gcig pu yin na gzungs thag bsdu/ mang du yod tshe kha shas kyis sngags rgyun 'dzin na shā sa na kho na bzla/ gsol kha'i dbyangs rol rnams kho bos sbyar ba'i mdos deb bzhin/ lcam dral ltar na gsol kha bar pa la/ gzhan yang yum chen u ma de wi/ e ka dza ti/ kun tu bzang po'i rig ma/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs gzhung bzhin la/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad pa'i rjes su bran bdud gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du sogs/ yum chen dang lha mo bran bdud kyi gtor sngags rnams kyis phul/ gsol kha gsum pa la shā sa nas chog lha brgyad ltar na gzhung bzhin/ gsol kha rdzogs pa'i mthar rol mo nyis brdeg len can du bsgyur/ mnga' gsol shlau ka dang por srin thung gi dbyangs rol/ de nas rnga 'phar ma sogs rgyun bzhin la/ khams gsum dgra bo'i srog dbugs la/ zhes pa'i bar rnga nang rdung / de nas dbang zhing rngams pa la tshig rol gyi mthar dgu brdung gcig gzungs thag dang sngags thun bsdus/ rnga phyir brdung 'phar ma dang bcas/ hūm̐ dam can rgya mtsho nas/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa la tshig rol gyi mthar rnam sras bstod kyi mgo bzhin/ dgu brdung 'then rkang can du bsgyur/ bran bdud kyi bskul shlau ka gcig la gur drag mtshams gcod kyi dbyangs rol/ de nas rnga 'phar ma phyir rdung / rdzogs nas tshig rol dgu rdung / chems brdung drag dung gsum brdeg len can/ mgon po 'khor bcas nas nus ldan du gyur gyi bar brjod/

bcom dung gsum brdeg len can bsangs lugs kyi bcom rol/ 'bul tshig shlau ka gcig la dus gsum bde gshegs ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin rnga 'phar ma nang rdung / lcam dral ltar na 'dod khams ma zhes pa'i rjes su bran bdud nag po lcam dral dang / /sde brgyad bshan par bcas pa kun/ /zhes pa man 'dra/ lha brgyad ltar na/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud bcas kyi rjes su/ sde brgyad bshan pa sogs yar 'then la yongs rdzogs rdzogs nas tshig rol chems rdung / mjug gur drag mchod rol lugs/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug sogs rab gnas kyi brtan bzhugs dang 'dra ba tshar gsum la drag rol gsum rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can/ de nas bkra shis 'os mtshams kyi mthar rol mo'i sgra rgya cher byas la/ mjug chog rgyun bzhin/ brtan bzhugs las gshegs gsol ni ma dgos so/ /yang lha brgyad kyi steng zhal bsnon na/ bskyed chog spyan 'dren gtor bsngo sbags sgrub bzhin bran bdud kyi dmigs bsal ni gong dang 'dra/ spyan 'dren la dad ring gi dbyangs 'khor bzhi/ de'i 'og shlau ka gnyis la swa ring bu dbyangs rol mo bcas/ gzhan thug chog nang bzhin 'byin 'jug med par btang bas nor 'khrul med do/ /lha mo rkyang pa'am/ zhal dmag zor ma/ las mgon sogs la so sor ru mtshon 'dzugs na de dag gi dbye ba'ang rnam dpyod can gyis tshar chen gyi gsung 'di kho na la gzhi byas/ dmigs bsal rang rang gi chos skor nas kha bskangs bas nor 'khrul med cing phun sum tshogs pa zhig yong ngo / /da lta gdan sa 'di na ru mtshon 'dzugs chog bsam don lhun grub ces pa zhig 'dug kyang / sa skya'i gong ma sogs chos skor 'di rgyus yod cig gis brtsams pa mi 'dra ste/ tshar chen rin po che'i gsung la 'byin 'jug byas pa rnams ma 'grig cing / dmag zor ma lta bu la ru mtshon bca' tshul med pas/ 'bul tshul 'di ji ltar drangs/

ru mtshon gyi yi ge rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang gi'ang khongs su mi 'jug ste/ mjug chog rgyas pa ni tshar chen gyi yi ge 'di'i steng du yang gong ma'i gsung rab mang po nas bsdu dgos dang / 'bring po'i rgyas pa ni tshar chen gyi yi ge 'di nang bzhin dang / 'bring po dngos ni bshad ma thag pa ltar dang / bsdus pa ni chos skyong gang yin de'i bskang gso'i mjug tu ru mtshon 'bul tshig kho na brjod kyang don tshang bas des na gong gi yi ge de cir 'gyur shes ldan rnams kyis gzigs pa zhu/ zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos smras pa'i yi ge pa ni bsod 'od kyis bgyis pa dge legs// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ lcam dral dang lha brgyad sogs kyi ru mtshon 'dzugs chog gi rnam bzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
